# owner: platform
from hourglass.parsing import format_span
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans

def _label(start, end):
    span = Span(start, end)
    return f"gap {format_span(span)} ({span.minutes} min)"

def _check_inside(spans, opening):
    for span in spans:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{format_span(span)} is outside opening hours"
            )

def find_gaps(worked, opening):
    """One label per stretch of opening hours nobody covers."""
    merged = merge_spans(worked)
    _check_inside(merged, opening)
    flat = [t for s in merged for t in (s.start, s.end)]
    points = [opening.start, *flat, opening.end]
    pairs = zip(points[::2], points[1::2])
    return [_label(a, b) for a, b in pairs if a < b]
